description: This file defines the GlEvents class in the org.apache.ofbiz.accounting package, containing a static method createReconcileAccount for processing accounting reconciliations, including fetching accounting entries, calculating balances, creating reconciliation records, and handling associated transaction entries.

classes.name: GlEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods related to general ledger event processing, notably creating reconciliation records.

methods.name: createReconcileAccount
methods.description: Processes selected accounting transactions from the request, calculates reconciliation balances, creates reconciliation records, and links individual entries. Returns 'success' or 'error' based on the operation outcome.
